notes.title: 🔥 MAJOR UPDATE v.1.1.24 | Rise of the Pixelian Household! 🏠👑
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/e3802ca4c0597280699256ee6586954cb70ab3f1.png"]



Hello, dear Pixelians! 👋


It’s been some time since the last update, and I’ve been pouring a lot of energy to bring more content and improve the existing features for you.



This update took a little longer to prepare, but I’ve got plenty of exciting things to share and I truly hope the wait pays off! 💖



While going through feedback from our community, I noticed many requests for more meaningful interactions with spouses and children. I couldn’t ignore these suggestions, and it was clear that we needed to take action. 🤝



So without further ado, let’s dive in! 🚀


🏠 Your Household


I am happy to say that family life in Pixelia just got deeper! This update introduces new ways to manage and enjoy your household, giving you more options to shape your daily life.



You can now hire household employees who will support you and your family in meaningful ways:


💼🧹 Household Employees


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/ee78e02b4ba50527150f3efa3f213727c99dc7b7.gif"]

There are four types of employees available for hire:

🧹 Housekeeper – Keeps your home tidy and ensures everything is in order.

👶 Babysitter – Takes care of your little ones while you focus on other activities.

📚 Private Tutor – Helps your children with their studies, boosting their growth and skills.

🐾 Pet Sitter – Looks after your pets, keeping them happy and healthy while you’re away.



Just like you can recruit employees to grow your business, you can now bring staff into your own home to support your household. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/df815b676fe2724d2b141a53f69e47360d697351.png"]



These employees aren’t just background characters, they’ll actively help you with a variety of daily tasks, making family life smoother and more dynamic.



Each employee also comes with their own unique traits and personalities, which can influence many aspects of your household dynamics, adding variety and depth to your family experience.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/2fdd345320ae4f7ede60167327da6ff5208be540.png"]
✨New Household Features:


Managing a household in Pixelia is a lot deeper and more dynamic than ever, with new systems that affect family life, relationships, and daily routines.



This update introduces deeper roleplay elements, bringing more personalization to your experience. Your home is no longer just a static backdrop, it is now a living, evolving environment where every decision you make influences family life and the relationships within it.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/281063dd16efb8c226383ff7009c548609924a22.png"]
🏠 Household Harmony 💖


Your family’s overall harmony now plays a crucial role in your domestic life. 



Keep it high, and your home runs smoothly. But if you neglect it, and there may be serious consequences. Household Harmony can increase or decrease depending on the actions of everyone living under your roof.



Even your spouse’s commitment is influenced by household harmony; if it drops too low, they may consider divorce, making this an essential aspect to manage carefully. 



That's right! If there’s no peace and harmony at home, your spouse will take an action that can break your heart. 💔


🗑️ Garbage & Home Hygiene 🧼


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/b72851af7ceb106de7fcf31f71b6071b2928a974.png"]

The everyday actions of your household members now generate garbage, including pets, children, spouse and others. 



Poor home hygiene doesn’t just look messy but it can increase the risk of disease and negatively impact your family’s health as well as affecting their overall happiness. Maintaining a clean home becomes a meaningful task, requiring attention to waste management and organization.


💌 Spouse Happiness & Daily Wishes

Your spouse now has daily wishes and desires that, when fulfilled, boost their happiness. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/2b2e93b7115e31e8d7ebc961e8a3f91c28a4d6ee.png"]

A happy spouse brings not only emotional benefits but also practical perks. Increased spouse happiness can unlock new abilities for them, such as:

🛒 Going shopping for household supplies

🍳 Preparing meals for the family

💰 Assisting with household budgeting

✨ And more unique interactions



You can now also view a summary of your spouse’s recent actions, thoughts, and emotions, along with their effects on the household. This feature helps you understand their needs better.



Together, these systems make managing your home a more immersive and rewarding experience, where each decision affects both your family’s happiness and daily efficiency.


👨🏼‍🤝‍👨🏻 Roommates


Now you can live with roommates in your home! 🏠



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/059f5f273b19858fede513669ecf22e3450737bb.png"]

They can help share the rent, making life a little easier and a lot more interesting.



Each roommate has their own personality, so every interaction is unique. They can get along with your family and staff, or sometimes cause mischief if their traits aren’t ideal.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/7eab4246458170bcfe3f0310568d47b964957b79.png"]

Roommates with bad traits can affect household harmony, lower your spouse’s happiness, or even make your household staff quit.



Choosing the right roommate adds fun, strategy, and surprises to your home life, making every day a little more unpredictable!



📝You can also decide to renew your lease with a roommate or ask them to move out early by paying a penalty fee. 💰




👶 All about Pixelings! 


Pixelings have grown more detailed and interactive than ever! They now feature enhanced portraits and can communicate with you when you’re nearby, making your interactions feel more personal and immersive.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/86608396d7644b242f8cb26c71114c04080d536b.gif"]



Each Pixeling comes with three core skills: Speech, Manners, and Education, which grow over time and unlock new behaviors and actions.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/fddef5e4a4c5ea2beb5e9bff39f330c30a8d2bea.png"]

Speech 🗣️ : At first, your Pixeling communicates in barely understandable gibberish. As their Speech skill increases, they start to talk more clearly, allowing for richer interactions.



Manners 🎩 : This skill affects their behavior at home. A high Manners level ensures they act politely and responsibly, while low Manners can lead to misbehavior, generating more trash and lowering household harmony.



Education 📚 : A higher Education skill unlocks bonus actions and activities that you can observe directly in their profile. These actions reflect their growing knowledge and abilities.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/c6b826d6e60a03e4dfd688132f5f5b46b3f75efa.png"]



Support from household staff also plays a key role in shaping Pixelings’ development:

A Babysitter 🧸 helps ensure your Pixelings generate less or no garbage at home.

A Private Tutor 📖 assists them in learning, helping their skills grow faster.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/9225dbbb12e6e522060030d01cc08581997ff8af.png"]

Additionally, you now have new Parenting options for direct engagement with your Pixelings. Once per day, you can:

Read a Story 📖

Help with Homework ✏️

Spend Time Together ❤️



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/7d8467a888c7d5f0122d1737e362cf9806068ed2.png"]

Engaging in these activities increases your Pixelings’ skills but comes at the cost of your Energy.



Together, these updates make raising Pixelings a more interactive and rewarding experience, where your guidance, attention, and the household environment all shape their growth and personality.


📱 Direct SMS Messages


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/7becf8964c1569efb7fad86b2e9d9802c5204a62.png"]

You can now receive direct SMS messages from your friends, rivals, or even your spouse, adding a new layer of depth and realism to relationships in Pixelia. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/f881929cc250fa34f2bc4c0b4a07d2d94201ceab.png"]

Your friends might reach out to catch up, hang out, or share a funny moment,

Your rivals could taunt or challenge you

Your spouse may send sweet messages, reminders, requests, or even let you know they’ve prepared a meal for you.

The content of these messages is influenced by your relationship with each Pixelian, making every interaction feel personal and meaningful.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/2681873d534b78606364172436797a804c3521c0.png"]



Receiving messages also allows you to respond and engage in real time, giving you opportunities to strengthen bonds, resolve conflicts, or unlock new social interactions.



This system encourages players to pay attention to their social relationships, as stronger connections can lead to more positive interactions, while neglecting them may result in tension or missed opportunities.



With Direct SMS messages, your social life in Pixelia becomes more dynamic, immersive, and responsive, reflecting the choices you make and the relationships you nurture.



Additionally, you will also receive direct messages when you complete certain quests.


Pausing Game during work


In response to frequent requests from our community, we’ve added the ability to pause the game while you’re at work.



Whether you need a quick break or just need some time to manage your schedule, this feature will ensure that you won’t lose progress.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/5677958aac7779880ca234341665fe38342417db.png"]


🐞 Bug Fixes


The issue where the UI reopened after closing the oven window during the Baker job has been fixed.



The problem where players received a “You have successfully resigned” notification after being fired from your job has been resolved.



When you had only one item in your inventory, if you wanted to store it into Drawers/Fridge or Trash Bin Inventory, you would lose that item. This issue has been fixed.


🛠 Minor Tweaks & Changes
💬 Added hundreds of new conversations. 

🎶 One new game music has been added. 

🛠  Minor adjustments have been done to existing UI. 

🕹  Family button in Profile has been replaced by Household. 




Thank you! ːstardropː
We really hope that you enjoy this update! 



If you’re having fun with the game, leaving a review on Steam really helps us out as we read every one and it helps other players discover it. 



Thank you all for your amazing support and love! 💖







[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/150cb89b34fd22ddcb5cb356824a0f5a7877ef94.gif"]  



We’ll continue adding bigger features, expanding content, and bringing our vision for Pixelia to life, while also listening closely to your requests.

notes.title: 📢 UPDATE v.1.0.23 | 🍳 Cooking Enhancements & Lease Termination 📝
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/1f0dc0e9b011126ce0002eedd8811a9d0f3da563.png"]



Hi there, dear Pixelians! 👋



We're excited to roll out a fresh batch of features and improvements!



This update includes several quality-of-life enhancements inspired by community suggestions, as well as a number of bug fixes. 



Big thanks to everyone who reported bugs and shared feedback as it really helps us stay focused and improve the game more effectively! 💖


🍽️ Using Items Stored in Drawers & Fridge


Previously when you were going to cook something, you had to have required Ingredient items stored in your Inventory.



Now, if you don’t have them in your Inventory but they’re stored in your Fridge or Drawers, the cooking system will automatically detect and use them from your home storage.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/bff8c0d16e476924b124ee2362159c24f3d27b5b.png"]

If the same ingredient exists in both your inventory and Fridge/Drawers, the system will prioritize using the one from your Inventory first.



You’ll now see icons showing the source of each ingredient, whether it’s taken from your Inventory or from home storage like the Fridge or Drawers.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/161fb1f1d94452575cf47ac7ffaab9c2af00d60d.png"]
🏠 Terminating Your Lease


You now have the option to end your current lease agreement at any time! 



Whether you're planning to relocate, upgrade to a better place, you can terminate your rental contract through the housing interface.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/ddd742d803fefc83e8bd3d71e120ce21411ef63f.png"]  

Once terminated, you’ll be moved out immediately and your furniture will be sent to Storage Inventory.



You’ll also receive 4💲 for every unused hour left on your lease. This new feature gives you greater flexibility in managing your housing.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/fab11b96b0ddc6717943364121f1b0446d0207d4.png"] 
🛠 Bug Fixes & Tweaks


In addition to these new features, we’ve also addressed several bugs reported by the community.



The issue where sleeping didn’t restore energy and time only progressed irregularly while your Store was open has now been fixed.



A bug causing time to stop or advance unpredictably while your Business was open has also been resolved.



Previously, opening your store remotely via phone prevented employee details from showing in the Daily Sales Report. This is now fixed and no longer an issue.



Wall decorations and placeable items were mistakenly sent to your Inventory instead of Storage Inventory; this has been fixed in this new version and should now work as expected.



A visual glitches near the Community Center has been fixed.



We’ve also revised one of the "Elite Fighter" dream goals, which involves beating 25 Pixelians up. Previously, progress was only made by beating civilians up, but now victories in boxing matches will count toward this goal as well. This change will ensure that you don't have to commit a crime for completing this goal.


✨ What's Next?
We have been working on Cloud Save support and only thing that is left now is to test it before we release this feature. After our tests are completed, we will make this feature public. 



In our next update, we will focus completely on optimization and adding rotation options for new items.


🐞 For everyone that is experiencing bugs;


I truly appreciate all the bug reports you send as they make our bug fixing process so much smoother! 🙏



What helps even more is having access to the save files where these bugs occur. Sometimes I can't reproduce the issues on my end, but reviewing your save files lets me pinpoint and solve problems quickly.



So, if you encounter any bugs, please feel free to join our Discord and send me a direct message describing the issue. You can find me under the role of "Developer" in our Discord channel. Send me a message and I’ll guide you on how to share your save file, and I'll work to fix the bug you experience in the next update. 🙂



Thank you for being such an amazing community! Now, it’s time to gradually focus on delivering bigger features, expanding content and moving closer to our overall vision. We're just getting started. 👀



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/150cb89b34fd22ddcb5cb356824a0f5a7877ef94.gif"]

notes.title: ⭐ UPDATE v.1.0.22 | Job Simulation System Introduced! 👔
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/be9d202e43cbfc94cacf80c52ce721e397f0a9b2.png"]



Hello, dear Pixelians! ːespressoː



This update introduces a new quality-of-life feature aimed at making things easier for your Pixelian. 



We’ve also implemented several community-requested additions and addressed various bugs for a smoother experience. 



Let’s jump right in! 👀


Simulating Your Shift ⏰


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/82c8106ef8d3b6f88df6ce0feb45d3a8fb196edf.png"]

In this new update, as well as updating visuals of the job start window, we are introducing a brand-new feature. 



From now on, once you reach Level 3 in your current job, you'll have the option to simulate your work shift if you prefer.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/117723fd3407b766dae9ede2082439bd22f69f20.png"]

The results of a simulated shift will depend on your current Job Level and Mood. However, choosing to simulate comes with a trade-off.



You'll earn less Job Experience, and even if your simulated performance is rated A, you won’t receive any Bonus.



You'll be able to watch your Pixelian's performance as the shift timer counts down, with a summary detailing what happens during their work. So, be sure your Pixelian is in a good mood before starting their shift. 🙂


📢 Other Updates & Bug Fixes 🐞


Along with this update, we have brought a few improvements as well as fixes for some bugs we've identified.



When your rent ended or you sold your home, your items were correctly sent to Storage—except for those stored in your Fridge or Drawers, which were lost. 



This issue has now been fixed, and affected items should now appear in Storage.


Note: If you currently have items in your Fridge or Drawers, please remove and place them again to ensure they’re saved. Otherwise, they may still be lost. But any item that you place from now on will be saved and sent to Storage Inventory.



We’ve also added the ability to place or take items in batches of 10 when using Drawers, Fridges, or Trash Bins.



Additional fixes include:

Resolved a bug where pets spawned outside the walls in two-room apartment.

Fixed an issue where book writing progress would reset to Quality F after reloading the game.

Adjusted the exclamation mark position in the “Kneading” cooking tutorial (Neighbor Quest) for better visibility, as that exclamation icon previously blocked some interaction options.

Fixed a visual glitch affecting the Bottomtown Bench.

The "Family Person" dream (Reach 7 Hearts with any Pixelian) should now progress correctly.

UI for Cooking has slightly changed & been improved. 

We have enabled Steam Deck Controller Support for Demo.


💬 Ongoing Updates


We're still addressing a few bugs that some of our community have encountered, and those fixes will be included in an upcoming update.



In the meantime, the next update will focus on performance optimizations and Cloud Save support.



Following that, we plan to work on complete Steam Deck verification and continue adding new content & features for the game. I’m noting down all your suggestions and bug reports. While it takes a bit of time to implement everything, we’re steadily working through them one by one and making progress. 😊



French language support is currently in progress and will be added to the game once the translation is complete. We're also open to including other languages if volunteers are available. Feel free to contact me on Discord if you're interested in helping! ːtabbycatː

notes.title: 🔥 UPDATE v.1.0.21 | Summer Sale & Demo Update, New Features and More! 👀
notes.content:
Hello once again, dear Pixelians! ːespressoː



This update took a bit longer than expected,  but we’re very excited to bring you another update that is thoughtfully designed based on the valuable feedback from all of you!



In this release, we’re addressing a challenge that’s been affecting some of you and now we’re introducing a new feature that directly targets the issue. 👀


🧰 Minigame Settings


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/227e20ee1900ffa4864adc115db39580eae65e9a.png"]

We’re excited to introduce a brand-new section in the Settings menu dedicated entirely to mini-game customization!



This feature gives you the ability to adjust each individual mini-game according to your personal preferences.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/c11c303e92e683b68bd5fd088a4868411eaf7455.png"]

You now have full control over your mini-game experience! 



With the new settings, you can choose to enable or disable any mini-game in the game, giving you the freedom to focus on the ones you enjoy most.



Additionally, you can adjust the difficulty level for each mini-game individually, allowing you to have control over your experience even more, whether you’re looking for a more relaxed experience or a tougher test of your skills.


🎯 How do 'Disabled Minigames' work?


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/80893e2850dafa1d80476de014c11478bbf6ac36.png"]

When you choose to disable a mini-game, your Pixelian will take care of those activities on their own. The outcome will be determined entirely by your Pixelian’s relevant skill level for that specific task.



For simpler activities that don’t rely on any skill; like taking a bath, using the toilet, running on the treadmill, or lifting weights; your Pixelian will complete them automatically, without any input needed from you.


🎶 What about Concerts and Side Jobs?


As you know, certain activities; like Concerts and Side Jobs (those you receive through your mobile phone); involve performing on an instrument or creating a painting for a client.



If the mini-game required for one of these tasks is disabled, a pop-up will appear before you begin, asking if you’d like to simulate the mini-game instead.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/c22cedd9cc1e74e6fc203aeeba6d5fffa6ff56f2.png"]

This allows your Pixelian to handle those side jobs entirely on their own, with the outcome based solely on their relevant skill level. 



The event will be simulated, and depending on how skilled your Pixelian is, you may either succeed or fail.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/0a7e2c06aec4f2d6ca6258331c899135ccf67460.png"]

This setting is especially valuable for players with physical challenges that made it difficult to actively participate in mini-games, often leading to failure and reducing their overall enjoyment of the game. 



We hope this new option removes that barrier and allows everyone to enjoy the experience more comfortably and fully.


💰 Jobs


For now, mini-games related to jobs are excluded from this feature, as we have separate plans for them.



We're considering allowing players to simulate their workdays, similar to this system, but likely only after reaching a certain level in that job. 



Simulating a shift may come with drawbacks such as missing out on bonuses or performing slightly worse than usual. We plan to introduce these adjustments in future updates.


📢 Other News

We’ve got two exciting updates to share with you! 👀


⭐ To Pixelia will be available at a 20% discount during the Steam Summer Sales, running from June 26th to July 10th.



⭐ In addition to the discount, we’re thrilled to announce the release of our updated Demo during the sale period, giving new players a chance to experience the latest improvements and features firsthand.


Thank you! 💖


If you haven’t joined us yet, we warmly welcome you to our Discord community, a place where you can connect, share your suggestions, and help shape the future of the game with your valuable feedback.

notes.title: 📢 UPDATE v.1.0.20 | Key Rebinding Update – Play Your Way! 🎮
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/2d604f1503c7bdbd0da8bf449cc06c8414c1957c.png"]



Hello dear Pixelians! ːespressoː



We’re back with another update crafted to meet the needs of our amazing community! 



We’ve heard that some of you were running into trouble with the default keyboard layout, and we knew it was time to give you full control. 🛠️ 



This update introduces Complete Key Rebinding Support for both Keyboard & Mouse, allowing you to customize your controls exactly how you like them. Alongside this, we’ve included a number of bug fixes to improve your overall experience.


🕹 Complete Key Rebinding


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/6f8486be2b722c0a964a42f5e3f2cbd73705ec6c.png"]

With this update, you now have the ability to customize over 80 keybindings, giving you full control over how you interact with the game. 



This includes everything from general movement to more specific systems like mini-games and UI interactions.



We’ve made sure that nearly every aspect of the game can be tailored to your personal preferences, so you can play in the way that feels most comfortable and intuitive to you. 




✅ Bug Fixes


Resolved an issue that prevented players from entering concerts when working as a Guitarist.



Fixed a bug where parking your vehicles in specific lots caused them to appear in incorrect locations.



Player movement is now properly reflected during Basketball matches and while driving, fixing the issue where modified keys had no effect.



Fixed a bug where an incorrect notification would appear about missing band members when attempting to start a concert through your Manager.



Adjusted the exit points of the Pharmacy Store, Lulu's Boutique and Tech Center to prevent players from being hit by cars upon leaving the buildings.



You can now perform with a microphone right at home! (In next updates, we will allow players to carry the microphone around, so you'll be able to take your performances outside and sing anywhere you like.)



Minor spelling errors in the English localization have been corrected.

 
🔮 A Glimpse Into the Future


These are some of the things what we're currently working on;



A new feature that will allow players to adjust the difficulty settings for all mini-games, giving you more control over how you want to experience them.



Option to toggle these mini-games on or off entirely, making the gameplay experience even more flexible and accessible.



Introducing some new features and improvements specifically related to the Jobs system.



Integrating Steam Cloud saving in a future update. This will make it much easier to access your progress across multiple devices, giving you a seamless and secure gameplay experience.



Specific adjustments for Steam Deck users.



New clothes, hairstyles and a variety of additional customization choices! 👗



As always, we truly appreciate your ongoing support and thoughtful feedback! It plays a key role in guiding the development of To Pixelia in a direction that reflects the wishes and needs of our wonderful community. 💖

notes.title: ⭐ UPDATE v.1.0.19 | Guitar Minigame Revamp & New Social Media App! 🎸📱
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/ee0ff800bac95a31db0e7dbd6934737b4cca58cb.png

Hello dear Pixelians! 🙌

This update comes with exciting news! The notorious Guitar Minigame has been revamped and is now much more easier than before. 

But before we dive into the details, let’s take a look at everything included in this update.


✨ Highlights of Update [v1.0.19] 

📱 Social Media

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/ebb2b006e8bde271e4124dfada64b2d53567f72b.gif

Pixelians, this update isn't just for the game, your Pixelian’s phone is getting an upgrade too!
A brand-new app is being introduced that lets you fast-forward time while boosting your Mood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/a2ecd070fcf6c1bb7c612fd515bbd9dbad716343.png

To keep things healthy for your Pixelian, your daily social media usage is capped at 5 hours. That means you can fast-forward up to 5 in-game hours per day, all while gaining a Mood boost.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/359608c798f6b4b5ec6e8cffb43251089347ebaa.png

And we’re just getting started! We’re planning to add even more apps to both your Pixelian’s phone and computer in future updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/028357d2c587f13ca962ab3d26ae1655b6033eeb.png

🎸 New Guitar Minigame

We understand that many players found the Guitar Minigame to be overly challenging.
As a result, we’ve thoughtfully redesigned it to provide a more easier and less frustrating experience for all of you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/c19aa44401ef220bbc452df8557a7015f9f642e7.png

By integrating familiar mechanics from other minigames we already have, the updated version now delivers a much more intuitive and easier gameplay flow.

In this new version, you’ll only need to focus on one note at a time, a significant simplification compared to the previous version, where you had to manage four notes simultaneously.

Additionally, the control scheme has been updated: the minigame now uses the arrow keys on keyboard, or the D-Pad when playing with a controller or on Steam Deck.

While reworking the minigame, we also took the opportunity to enhance the user interface.

Since kneading and baking takes a lot of time, we’ve extended the customer wait time by 15 seconds to reduce pressure during the process.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/e4f63185f75df65ba53cf671c3b687b361d9199f.png

Dear Pixelians! 👋

This patch brings a fresh wave of quality-of-life improvements, new content, and community-requested features to make your experience smoother, more fun, and even more immersive. 

Let’s dive into what’s new! 🚀

Highlights of Update [v1.0.18] 

Storage Inventory

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/ffecb85d135aa7174427b90eb1d60ce550b701cb.png

This update introduces a brand-new feature: Storage Inventory 📦

You’ll be able to access it straight from the Furnishing Window while at home, and it’s shared between all of your properties. If you miss your rent and get evicted, or decide to sell your property without including furniture, all your items will be safely transferred to your Storage Inventory.

I’ve also added a new option that lets you manually send any of your furniture to your Storage Inventory whenever you’d like.

Say goodbye to losing your hard-earned furniture during tough times in Pixelia! 🏡

🎯 Pin the Pixelian! – NPC Waypointing Arrives!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/7dd046290d17cc8d6e9ec42b528ce2c30b431158.png

Ever found yourself circling Pixelia over and over, just trying to track down that one elusive Pixelian for a quest? Or maybe you've resorted to waiting outside their home like a detective on a stakeout? Finding the right person at the right time hasn’t always been easy in earlier versions.

With our new NPC Waypoint System, that hassle is finally a thing of the past! 🗺️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/9d2d7e5281b4c9711cd1d08f405d2183e14fb522.png

You can now place a waypoint on any NPC, allowing you to instantly locate them on the map and track them in real-time. Whether you're on a mission, handing in a task, or just looking to say hi, finding the right Pixelian is now as easy as pie.

No more hide-and-seek! ✨

Purchasing Rented Properties Made Easier!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/982bba0e67375a1742d970f64c331eae383492b3.png

Previously, you had to wait until your rental period expired, and often faced eviction, before you could buy a rented home. And even worse, when you got evicted, your ruthless landlord would sell off your furniture to cover costs. This meant that buying your rented home involved a lot of hassle and difficulties.

Now, with this new feature, you can purchase your rented property at any time, without waiting for the lease to end or dealing with eviction hassles!

You can purchase your rented property through the Housing menu or by visiting the Real Estate Office.

Ghoulies Safecracking Quest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/153178e7202ac283242fee17bef9ed0240099681.png

This quest now features a handy option to highlight the specific home you need to lockpick and break into to access the safe, making your mission clearer and easier to complete.

 💬 Skipping Dialogues

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/ae4273f8f9c26d7644527386133bf6dbcfdc4aca.png

This isn’t a new feature, but we didn’t communicate it clearly before, which was our oversight. You’ve always been able to skip dialogue, but since we didn’t mention it, many in our community were unaware. 

To fix this, we’ve now added a visual hint to let you know you can skip and don’t have to wait for any Pixelian during conversations.

💾 More Reliable Save System!

We understand how frustrating it can be to lose your progress due to corrupted save files when a crash occurs during manual or auto-saving. Previously, interruptions during the save process could damage your save data, causing you to lose your game progress.

To prevent this, we’ve implemented an additional safety measure. 

Now, when you save your game, the original save file remains untouched. The game first creates a temporary copy of your save file, writes the new data onto that copy, and only replaces the original file once the process completes successfully. This way, if a crash or interruption happens during saving, your original save will stay intact, protected and untouched.

Other Minor Tweaks


 Hacking Bank Accounts and Stealing Data on computers now takes much less time.

 If your hacking attempt fails, the Crime UI will appear to display the amount of Crime Points you've gained.

 Controller support has been added for the Butcher Job.


✅ Bug Fixes


 To view concert offers from your Music Band manager, you needed 5 Composed Music. However, if you had a Music Album containing 10 Composed Music, the game didn’t correctly recognize that this requirement was met. This issue is fixed now.

 Successful government hacking actions on the computer now count correctly toward the "Mastermind Criminal" dream goal.

 Resolved a bug where the "Write Book" mini-game window remained open if your character experienced a bladder accident during the book writing process.

 Fixed the Trait Task "Eat 3 Seafood" so that eating Cooked Salmon now counts properly.

 Relationship values will no longer drop below -100 when attacking someone.

 Corrected the price range for the product "Solar Bloom" in the Cosmetics Store.

 Corrected the incorrect furniture category title for beds in the Furnishing Menu.



And there’s more news! If everything goes smoothly, the upcoming update will wrap up the long-awaited revamp of the notorious Guitar Minigame. Following that, we’ll start rolling out options to turn mini-games on or off.


Feel free to join our Discord group to share your suggestions and feedback. We always listen closely and take every comment into consideration.

 The issue preventing graduation from Pixelian Academy is now resolved! If you're playing on an existing save where the bug occurred, just head over to the college, talk to the headmaster, and interact with him to graduate. If you’re starting a new game, everything should work as expected without any action needed.


📘 Quest Fixes & Progression:

 The quest requiring you to raise any skill to 15 is now working correctly and should auto-complete if conditions are met.

 The Roughnecks' quest to defeat someone has been fixed.

 The Dream Task “Reach 100 Crime” now tracks progress accurately.

 Previously, aspiring criminals were losing 24 Crime points daily, making it hard to progress. We've rebalanced this. Crime now decreases by a random amount between 1 and 7 each day.

 You can now play Digital Keyboards directly from your inventory.

 Character walk and run speeds increased by 10%.

 Previously, accessing the Basketball Arena required Prestige Level 10, even if the Coach had invited you. Now, once you receive an invitation, you’ll be allowed in right away, no Prestige requirement needed.



💳 Banking Updates:
 You can now make hospital payments using your Credit Card.

 The issue with increasing Credit Card limits is fixed. You can now spend 25 Prestige Points to boost your limit by 2,500P.


🍅 Ketchup Crisis Solved:
 Turns out, ketchup had mysteriously vanished from all of Pixelia. But don’t worry! We’ve restocked every supermarket! Our sincerest apologies for the saucy inconvenience. 😅


NEW FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS!

Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've added some new features and made updates to help improve your overall experience!

Intro Guides for Mini-Games
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/b599a4b24de5c413e7a2c4f8603fe2ce7db8ba48.png

Now, whenever you try a mini-game for the first time, a helpful pop-up will appear to explain how it works.


💾 Better Auto-Saving System
 Auto-Save is now enabled by default for all new games! If you’re playing with an existing save file, you can still enable Auto-Save manually from the Pause Menu.

 We’ve also increased the save frequency. Your game will now auto-save every 1 minute and 30 seconds instead of every 5 minutes, offering better protection against progress loss!



New Optional Features to Make Your Pixelian Life Easier!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/98c11a606624e8872d17a127fb800dfdfe5edec6.png
We’ve added four new settings to help tailor the experience to your playstyle, and it is completely optional!

🕹 Key Rebinding
 This was one of the most requested features, especially by players who had difficulty with certain key layouts. For now, you can rebind a select set of keys, and we’ll be expanding this to include more,  particularly mini-game controls. So you can fully customize your setup soon!


📈 Skill Progression Speed
 Don’t feel like grinding? No problem. You can now choose how quickly your skills progress while practicing. Select from Normal, Fast, or Very Fast. Your pace, your rules. 👀


⚡ Needs Decay Rate
 You now have control over how quickly your Needs; like Energy, Hygiene, Hunger, Toilet, and Mood drop over time.


🗺 Reveal the Full Map
 Having trouble finding your way around Pixelia? You can now spend 250 Prestige Points from the Pause Menu to instantly uncover the entire map. Easy exploration, if that’s your thing!



A Final Note:

I’m incredibly grateful for all the feedback you’ve shared as it really helps shape the game. While a few bugs may have slipped by, don’t worry, we’re on top of them. Bugs can happen, but that doesn’t mean they’re here to stay. 🐞

I’ve also started working on optimization improvements to tackle the crashing issues some of you have encountered.

Lastly, if you’re enjoying To Pixelia and have a moment to leave a Steam review, it would mean a lot and help more people find the game.

Thanks again for all your support!

-Kaan

notes.title: Pixelian City Planning: Key Rebindings, Crashes, and Credit Cards, Oh My!
notes.content:
Hey Pixelians!

How is everyone settling into their new home? What a day yesterday was! I want to thank you all for your kind messages and incredible support. Despite a good amount of testing before launch, a few issues still managed to slip through. I also had to make some last-minute adjustments and temporarily disable certain features to comply with Steam’s release requirements. Unfortunately, this caused some disruptions for players, and I’m working as quickly as possible to resolve everything.

Today, I’d like to give you a peek behind the scenes at what’s happening:

✅ Bugs Fixed Yesterday:
Many of you noticed that your Pixelians were constantly getting sick. That was a traumatic experience—not just for you, but for the overwhelmed doctors of Pixelia too! Thankfully, this issue has been addressed, and things should be back to normal.

🔧 What I'm working on right now:

Key Bindings – This has been a popular request, and I fully agree with the feedback. Key remapping is on the way, and it will also help lay the groundwork for improved controller support.

Controller Support – The game currently offers partial controller support, but it’s far from ideal. I'm actively working on a better implementation. It’ll take a bit of time, but it will get done.

Steam Deck Support – The game is technically playable on Steam Deck, but not to the level I’d like—or that you deserve. This will be improved alongside the controller support work.

In the meantime, a helpful tip from a community member named "giantbug":
Go into your Steam Deck controller settings and switch the configuration for the game to the “Controller with Camera Control” template instead of “Keyboard with Mouse.” This should make gameplay much smoother and will also correctly display in-game button prompts (like “A”, etc.).

Cloud Saves – Definitely coming soon. I want you to be able to share your save files seamlessly between machines.

Skill Balance – I’m reworking the skill system to make it more rewarding and less grindy to level up.

 Bonus Fixes & World News:

The hospital only accepted cash, refusing your credit cards—unacceptable! I’m currently in negotiations with them to allow credit card payments.

Meanwhile, the President of Pixelia is considering introducing a bill to cap daily casino profits. However, he’s worried about getting impeached, so... more debates are underway.


Lastly, I would like to kindly ask, if you do like the game, please consider leaving a review. It helps the game in a long run and allows more people to discover it, helping me to expand the game even more

What was the issue?
Firstly there were around 6-7 different stores where players could buy furniture, wallpapers, carpets, and more.

The issue was that many testers had trouble finding all of these stores in game map. For instance, they would buy wallpapers not knowing how many pieces were needed to cover an entire wall, so when just one or two were missing, players had to go all the way back to the store. And what if they wanted to change it later? Imagine going all the way back to the store and do it all over. This was a major issue that needed addressing 🤝

Build Mode

notes.title: Release Date Delay
notes.content:
Dear Future Pixelians 

First off, I want to extend a HUGE thank you to everyone who participated in the demo, whether during Next Fest or in August, and for all the incredible feedback and pointing out things that we could improve further!  

I would love to finally clarify those questions about the release date which most of you have been asking about and be completely transparent in our thought process;  

The original plan has been to release To Pixelia in Q3 2024 and this timeline was always our main goal. However after re-evaluating our goals, ideas together with my publisher team who have been assisting me a lot throughout my journey, it’s become clear that sticking to the current release date won’t allow enough time to fully realize everything we’ve envisioned for the game. So, what does it mean?

First and foremost, I really want to make sure that your expectations will be not just met but exceeded. While it is very possible that the game could be released with its current content and features, I believe it truly can be improved and get even better. 

And although it might make more commercial sense for me to release it now, I care about making To Pixelia the best it can possibly be as I share the same passion as you all. That’s why I’d be happy to take a bit more time to polish everything, go through all of your feedback, refine the game, add more features & content and complete porting to more platforms, conduct more testing and finalize localization in as many languages as possible. 

Currently, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, and German are being translated, but I’d like to have more languages added to the full version, such as French and Chinese and potentially some more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/a88f6aca28ab14ae81e574bb7b940f5803e9d756.gif

Beyond this, some of the things I plan to bring to the game during this time include;


 Being able to open up your own business (restaurants, retail stores, entertainment venues, etc.) and manage aspects like inventory, employees, marketing, and customer satisfaction.
 The game needs to definitely have more jobs, pets, farm animals, vehicles and customization options  free from gender. for the full release version. There will be also new storylines & quests as well!
 I’d like to add more crime opportunities to south part of the Pixelia, so there will be some societies and  factions for you to discover.
 Your in-game phone will also have more applications, enhancing the way you interact with the world and its systems.
 I’ve also been wanting to expand the personality system to have hobbies and horoscopes  to allow you further define and shape your characters better.
 I’d also like to take some time to add some visual updates to the city itself, with enhanced textures and lighting effects, and even some -new building designs.


I hope you will love the upcoming changes to the game. All of this will be part of the full release, and it will enhance your experience as well  

Due to my lack of communication over the past few months, which is entirely my fault, as I was focused on getting everything done within Q3, some of you might have assumed that the potential delay was solely because of porting the game to Switch. The truth is, I really want to enhance your experience by adding even more depth and features to the game. However, instead of rushing through everything, I believe you all deserve a more polished and refined final product.

After carefully reconsidering everything, we’ve decided to move the release to within the first months of 2025 with a new target window of March/April. This may come off as bad news, but this decision is made with the best interest of our community in mind. 


I'd love to post regular monthly updates to inform you about all of this process, so transparency will not only be verbal, but you will have sneak peaks, images and so on.

And I'm truly grateful for all your support and I’m committed to exceeding the expectations with our hard work and dedication.

notes.title: [v0.2.0] A Major Update with Some Big News!
notes.content:
Hello dear Pixelians! 🖐

With a new season upon us, it's the perfect time for updates in Pixelia! It's been a while since my last update, so I'll be sharing as many details as possible.


This update will be divided into three sections: 

[olist]
 What's been done. ✅

 What's currently in progress. ⏳

 What's planned for the future. 🔭[/olist] 


Important Note: While it is not certain, it is anticipated that your current save files may encounter bugs due to significant changes made to the game in the past few months. These early versions are not stable, and many elements & features are subject to change based on your feedback. Thank you all for your incredible suggestions, ideas, and support!


1)  v0.2.0 Update Notes 📝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/5f0620c4e6b62a80155d6e6676d219628aa81219.png

Let's start with what we've already done:


-Pets 🐰🐱
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/9087220d99013b63cee160f066b8301506253c10.png
Beware! Your home has been taken over by our fluffy friends! 

We'd like to start by announcing that Pets have been added to the game. Currently, you can have Dogs, Cats, Rabbits, Hamsters, and Ducks roaming inside your home.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/b4a2740ae7cce3868c92e505dc503aa6eb013106.png
Following our Kickstarter goal: New Pets & Vehicles, we will continue to introduce more animal options, potentially expanding to around 20 different animal types initially.

Besides the variety of pets, we will also include special actions & tricks they can perform. You’ll be able to take your pets for walks, feed them, and build relationships with them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/876563dd3c7ddd81ebc9e736216427bd4f8db43f.png
At this early stage, we are focused on adding different animal types and designing their unique features. All these additions will be implemented in future updates.


-New Dialogue Options 💬 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/ec9456aaf9efb0b78fe8a14047b61cfa5443178e.png

Another exciting update involves our New Dialogue Options!

We've decided to remove the Insult and Blackmail options. In this early version of the game, these options lacked depth and didn't serve much purpose. Based on the feedback we've received, it made more sense to replace them with two new, more meaningful options.

Ask Questions ❓❔
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/d7ead4b9ad3657ccffe9f74c6b68a44601ae49be.png
So.. does the egg come first or the chick? 🐣

You can now ask other Pixelians questions, which are divided into two main categories: General and Private.

This new feature is the first step in giving each Pixelian a unique personality, as their responses will be tailored to their individual character.

You will be able to learn whom they like or dislike, and who their bestfriend is, what they do for a living, what their hobbies are and etc.. 

In the future, some of these informations will have some effect on your relationship with them. Being friends with their rival will surely have a negative effect. We will also increase amount of the questions and add specific traits for each one of them.

Give Gifts 🧧
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/6743557eb24617475abf8018c9f15138603a2192.png
Giving gifts will help you increase your relationship faster, but it will also take a toll on your wallet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/c7f33cb00b7c34a034a03d7801d8718d7af45da6.png
In general, you will also get some Reactions from each Dialogue option you choose.


-Mini games 🎯
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/3ad692fb7799062e56e350c14f1d6e5e33521dbf.png

Initially the way to develop skills were through mini games. At first, we have received feedback that some mini games were difficult for our players, also to increase your skills, playing 60 seconds of mini games repetitively would not be such a cozy experience in long term.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/969b5bff9b6529a4ffaa718b17bee7f2f8bc606d.png

We've introduced a solution inspired by traditional systems like those seen in other life simulation games.

Your Pixelian will now autonomously practice their skills, but this will slightly decrease their Mood. Excessive practice can lead to exhaustion and boredom, so it's crucial to ensure your Pixelian receives enough entertainment to counterbalance this.

This change applies only to skill practice and development. Mini games will still be part of the game for activities like creating art, composing music, writing a book or for side jobs. This update will prevent mini-games from becoming repetitive.

Furthermore, skill advancement has been optimized for faster progression.


-Homework 🧾
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/283c8ff3f0677406e7d76309e41a93a1b4519616.png

The mini-game for attending classes has also been removed. 

Now, your Pixelian's classroom success hinges on a combination of factors: their Mood, Intelligence, and level of preparation achieved through homework. 

With these elements in mind, your Pixelian's performance in the classroom will be determined.

-Inviting Other Pixelians to your Home. 🎀
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/16b30371249e994bb3c114fdfcf5eee62d9ef092.png

You can now open your door to other Pixelians and invite them to your cozy space when you have achieved a certain level of relationship. 

They'll spend time with you and interact with the objects in your home.


-Interests 🎈
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/1910ab690a08d74295538cc60188ca9ef3be2700.png
Your Pixelian's life would be dull without some interests of their own.

There are currently 6 Main Interests you will see;

 Family (More information in Work In Progress)
 Pets
 Politics (More information in Work In Progress)
 Basketball
 Music Band
 Boxing.

Each interest will come with its own set of requirements, but once you meet those, you'll have the freedom to form a band, establish a political party, join a basketball team, or become a licensed fighter. The decision is entirely up to you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/b89d790c0b4c9c367b76c5a096e943544c8aaf00.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/d931516408f625b516c7108352d49d44ce44f954.png


-Trait Tasks 🎴
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/1f1927bad87e97f147e1e7c8e38a3f06707cec68.png
Trait tasks have been adjusted to align with our 'skill practice' updates. Upon finishing each trait task, not only will your Prestige increase, but your Mood will also increase as you fulfill your character's desires based on their Trait.

Additionally, we're actively working on adding more methods to boost your Mood. This is certainly on our radar for enhancements.


-Sprint Can Be Toggled On. 🏃‍♂️💨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/80256847d81e443cb096d0a65f51b9a250dccd0b.png
Now you can toggle on Sprint instead of holding the Shift to run. Not only that, sprint will not decrease your Energy at all, so feel free to use it as much as you'd like 🤓

We're also considering tweaking the sprint speeds based on your character's Strength, providing a more dynamic experience.

Also, for those that have accidentally got into Fighting stance and found themselves in an uncomfortable situations, fret not, we've got you covered! We've included extra icons to guide you on how to deactivate it. 😅


-Minor Updates 📰
 Rent prices are lowered.
 Job salaries have been increased
 Bus tickets are lowered to half price.
 Stats are decreasing slightly slowlier.
 Changes/improvements in UI.
 Turkish language has been added.



-Minor Fixes 🧰
 Previous problem of having to enter the exclusive item codes for each characters is a thing of past now. Exclusive Kickstarter Outfits will be saved for all of your characters now. (You might need to enter the code for once again, just to get it saved).  
 Sequence error for Super Model job has been fixed.
 Being hit by a car after you get out of Art Studio has been fixed.




2) Works In Progress ⌛


Now let's get to what we are cooking 🍳🥄👨‍🍳

While not all features could be included in this update, many are currently in development behind the scenes. I'm eager to discuss these, as they'll certainly find their way into upcoming updates.


-Family 👶
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/a43370f6c724f6b17b9b50436cb59e12ded2c5b9.png

As hinted in the Interests section, our highly anticipated Family feature is nearing its completion. So, what can you expect?

You'll have the opportunity to marry Pixelians, free from any gender restrictions. Additionally, you'll be able to have children through adoption too.

These children will progress through various life stages, starting as babies, advancing to toddlers, and eventually becoming adults. The timing of their growth transitions will be optional, allowing you to control when they age up.

Furthermore, you'll have the ability to educate your children and help them develop new skills. Once they reach adulthood, they'll be capable of contributing financially to your household.

We're considering further optimizing wedding ceremonies, including options to select guests, and incorporating multiple scenes to enhance the experience.


-Pixenville 🌸
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/eac9406d9a3ef80f05d53636f66ded64e2c4e45e.png
To Pixelia was originally developed with the idea of keeping the game exclusively within an urban setting. However, why to put any limitations for those that want to enjoy both?

Originally, we aimed to introduce Pixenville alongside our Exclusive Beta Outfit, Pumpkin Pal. However, we decided not to rush its release until it was fully polished.

Soon, you'll have the opportunity to journey to Pixenville via train and immerse yourself in a vibrant new community. You can explore new areas, new jobs and enjoy the natural surroundings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/e72b24289e20160de4ba0611c96da76cf7924567.png
Fishing, tree chopping, and farming are just a few of the activities awaiting you in Pixenville, along with the introduction of new animals like cows, pigs, and horses. Additionally, you'll have the opportunity to purchase and navigate & customize your own yacht in the lake of Pixenville.


-Elections 🗳
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/83179d68e0ece7eb304abf55c349bb50a48743fc.png
Each year, presidential elections will take place, providing you with the opportunity to exercise your right to vote. 

You can establish your own political party and actively participate in these elections. However, your success will hinge on the level of effort you've invested leading up to the elections, necessitating the recruitment of assistants for various departments.

Should you emerge victorious in the elections, you'll gain the authority to enact new laws, adjust tax rates, and oversee a plenty of management tasks that lie ahead.


-Museum, Pawn Shop, Cinema, TV Studio and more! 🎥

At the moment, several buildings remain locked as they are still under development.

Museum will be a shop offering unique items that cannot be purchased with money. Instead, you'll need to spend your Pixelian's Prestige Points to unlock new outfits, hairstyles, facial styles, furniture, and more.

Pawn Shop, found in Bottom Town, will operate similarly but will feature random items every day, which you cannot find anywhere else.

TV Studio will provide new career opportunities, while the Cinema will be a place where you can take a date or visit alone.


-Localization
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/a88f6aca28ab14ae81e574bb7b940f5803e9d756.gif
Those langauges are our only way to understand the unique language of our beloved Pixelians. 🤓


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/a1ef5de4c5f627ba69e575b610b1a92c4e2a53b3.png
Our Alpha & Beta backers may have noticed that the game was previously only available in English. 

But now, we're excited to announce that our Localization process has kicked off, with Turkish becoming the second language added to the game. 


 Stay tuned for more languages coming soon! Additionally, we're planning to reach out to our community soon to see if anyone would like to lend a hand in this localization effort.





3)  What's In The Future?

-Steam Next Fest
🌟 We're thrilled to announce our participation in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, scheduled to run from June 10th to 17th. 🌟

During this event, everyone will have the opportunity to play a free public demo for a week, and we're eagerly anticipating your participation!

Following Steam Next Fest, we're planning to launch the game shortly thereafter.


Lastly, feel free to join our Discord if you'd like to be part of our community. 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/150cb89b34fd22ddcb5cb356824a0f5a7877ef94.gif





A little personal tribute
I'd like to take a moment to pay tribute to my beloved Felix, who passed away a month ago. He was not just my first cat, but the most wonderful companion I could have hoped for. 🐱

Felix was by my side for nearly the entire development journey of this game. I always pictured him staying with me for many years to come.

Rest in peace, my dear boy. 💖

notes.title: [v.0.1.0] Early Beta Release of To Pixelia is Out!
notes.content:
Hello, Pixelians!


As we are about to leave the winter behind and step into a new season renowned for agriculture and crops, To Pixelia also enters a new era with the Beta phase.

Initially conceived as an urban life simulator set in a city environment, our vision for Pixelia evolved to incorporate farming elements into the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/07546b3dd61bd9c3de15baf55dd3aa84dd7471d1.gif

We are on the verge of completing our new areas as well as fresh new features, which will bring farming, fishing, animal husbandry activities and completely new areas into the life of Pixelians.


What's new in the Beta phase?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43626503/b91db73f17691c11f93915b57fdb6fa0147454b3.gif

Alongside introducing new ways to personalize your experience, we're expanding the range of customization elements available to you.

This process unfolds gradually as we address bugs, introduce new features, and improve the existing ones based on feedback we have received.

In this update, we've introduced a new beard style, along with the ability to wear and customize new glasses and shoes and your Pixelian's eyes. You will have more control over your Pixelian's look.

What's in the future?

Looking forward, we plan to enrich customization options further, including the introduction of gender-neutral choices in the weeks to come, which will allow you to be able to use every existing hairstyle in the game.

Additionally, there will be new hairstyles, masks, new outfits and new pets added to the game.

We are also in the process of unlocking out all locked features, such as Bands, Political Parties, Boxing, and Basketball competitions, to ensure a more inclusive and accessible experience for all players. We want to unlock one feature at a time in weekly updates, 

And you will soon have another big update consisting of new characters, new area, new property and new features.
